                    ### Question
                    Which among the following NOT a pharmacological action of opioids

                    ### Options
                    opa. Cough suppression
opb. Anti-emesis
opc. Miosis
opd. Truncal rigidity

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Among the listed options, anti-emesis is not a pharmacological action of opioids. Opioids typically induce rather than suppress nausea and vomiting by stimulating the chemoreceptor trigger zone. Cough suppression, miosis, and truncal rigidity are all established effects of opioids, with cough suppression and miosis being particularly well-documented through the activation of mu receptors in the CNS.
